parties.petitioner: M/s Maxim India Integrated Circuit Design (P) Ltd.

summary: Land dispute involving mutation, tenancy, and impleadment; LRF No.835/74-75 dismissed in 1981 attained finality; non-joinder of vendor in tribunal proceedings led to quashing; remand held improper as reopening final order; delay of 1378 days condoned in writ appeal creating prejudice; impleadment without opportunity to contest on merits; High Court order allowing writ appeal set aside; appellant's right to property upheld; finality of proceedings emphasized.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; impugned judgment set aside; restoration of High Court's order in Writ Appeal No.206/2007 quashed; status quo ante restored; appellant's title recognized.
